about: Each change to frozen bridge code against the merge base, with one reason: moved (a rule moved into Rust, naming its task), refactor (behaviour kept) or gone (an entry that left the freeze). Entries the merge base already holds are spent and may be pruned.

packages/structured-data-models-client/s.moved: T1.32a: the entities' cast to the key's type moved into the core (sdm_engine::keys::cast); the bridge's table of the key types it cast to (_ARROW_TYPES) and its key_type refusal (_not_taken) are deleted, and it imports math for the host's own missing values

T1.32a: the cast to the key's type with pandas (pd.Series(indices, dtype=...)) and its INVALID_REQUEST and INTERNAL_ERROR split are the core's rule table; the bridge hands over the values as pyarrow infers them, or as their text where it infers no one type
T1.32a: the host's half of the moved cast: which of its own values are missing when it writes them as text (None, pd.NA, pd.NaT, a float NaN), the core reading a null
T1.32a: the bridge's key_type refusal, for a key type it had no cast for, is the core's (sdm_engine::keys::cast refuses a key type no rule casts to)
T1.32a: the entities are passed to the core without the schema or the entity's name, which only the bridge's cast read

T1.32g: the host's half of the moved cast (T1.32a's carried P3): a float in a mix written as the core writes a float entity (sdm_engine::keys's Entity::Float, Rust's Display of an f64: shortest round-trip digits, no exponent, a tie away from zero), so the core reads back the number the host was given; a boolean as before

T1.32h (P1B-12): the boundary conversion the owner authorized on 2026-10-13 (owner decisions item 18, decision E101): the bridge writes each key and time column as the contract's Given, and the refusals of a value that is not a name or a sequence of names (_as_key_tuple's, a time column's) are the core's (sdm-schema apply_keys_and_times); with D4 (P1B-74, the owner's), the host refuses a table named by anything but a str before the run, as JSON would write it as its text
